title: Student Management System
summary: A full-stack platform for managing student records, grades and attendance.
description: A role-based web application for schools to manage student enrollment, attendance and grade reporting. Built with a React front end and a Django REST API backed by MySQL, with separate dashboards for admins, teachers and students.
features: Role-based authentication for admins, teachers and students
Attendance tracking with exportable CSV reports
Grade book with automatic GPA calculation
Searchable, paginated student directory
challenges: Designing a permission system that cleanly separated what admins, teachers and students could see and edit, without duplicating logic across the API and the client.
learnings: Deepened my understanding of Django's permission classes and serializers, and how to mirror backend validation on the frontend for a fast, trustworthy UX.

title: School Website
summary: A responsive marketing and information site for a secondary school.
description: A static multi-page website for a school, covering admissions, academics, staff and news. Focused on accessibility and fast load times for visitors on low-bandwidth connections.
features: Fully responsive layout with a mobile navigation drawer
Accessible forms for admissions enquiries
Image-light design tuned for fast first paint
Vanilla JS scroll-spy navigation
challenges: Delivering a polished, animated experience using only vanilla JavaScript, without a framework to lean on for state management.
learnings: Reinforced core DOM APIs and taught me to be deliberate about performance budgets from the very first line of CSS.

title: Restaurant Website
summary: A visually rich single-page site for a fictional restaurant brand.
description: A single-page React application showcasing a restaurant's menu, story and reservation flow, with scroll-triggered animations and a mobile-first layout.
features: Animated hero with parallax food photography
Filterable menu by course and dietary tag
Reservation form with inline validation
Dark, moody theme matching the brand
challenges: Keeping animation-heavy sections performant on mid-range mobile devices.
learnings: Learned to profile and trim Framer Motion animations, and to prefer transform/opacity animations over layout-triggering properties.

title: E-commerce Website
summary: A full online store with cart, checkout and an admin product catalog.
description: A full-stack e-commerce application with product browsing, cart management and checkout on the frontend, backed by a Django REST API handling products, orders and authentication.
features: Product catalog with filtering, search and sorting
Persistent cart with quantity management
JWT-authenticated checkout flow
Admin dashboard for managing inventory
challenges: Keeping cart state consistent between the client and server, especially around stock levels during checkout.
learnings: Gained hands-on experience with optimistic UI updates and handling race conditions in an inventory system.

title: Personal Finance Tracker
summary: A budgeting dashboard for tracking income, expenses and savings goals.
description: A React application for tracking personal income and expenses, visualizing spending by category, and setting savings goals with progress indicators.
features: Interactive charts for spending by category and month
Savings goals with animated progress rings
CSV import for bank statement data
Local-first storage with export to JSON
challenges: Modeling recurring transactions and monthly rollovers in a way that stayed simple to reason about in the UI.
learnings: Improved my data-modeling skills and got comfortable building custom chart components on top of Recharts primitives.

title: Task Manager API
summary: A production-style REST API for managing tasks, projects and teams.
description: A Django REST Framework API providing authentication, task CRUD, project grouping and team assignment, designed as the backend for future task-management clients.
features: Token-based authentication and permissions
Nested serializers for tasks within projects within teams
Filtering, search and pagination on all list endpoints
Auto-generated OpenAPI documentation
challenges: Structuring serializers to avoid N+1 queries once tasks, projects and teams were deeply nested.
learnings: Learned to use select_related/prefetch_related deliberately and to reason about API design independent of any one frontend.
